Container.Name: Daybook
Container.Overview: Daybook syncs one practitioner's Jane/iCloud calendar every day, tracks every client session, and makes sure notes are confirmed. The desk view (/kiosk) shows today's plan with two large confirmations per session (no-show / done + notes), a cleanup list for sessions unconfirmed within 3 days, long-term follow-ups (30 days without a future booking), consent tracking, treatment-plan reminders (due by session 3, reviewed every 90 days, remade yearly), session location/modality/provider tracking, and a full day view including breaks and meetings. Also includes single-user password login, forced first-run credential setup, and passphrase-encrypted backups. Tracks billable hours and exports CSV. LAN-only by design; reach the desk device over WireGuard or Tailscale. No email or cloud service is required. This template pulls the image published by GitHub Actions.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Daybook web UI and desk/kiosk view

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Set this. Controls 'today', the 5pm reminder and displayed times.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container

Config.Name: Setup Username
Config.Description: First-run bootstrap username. You will be forced to choose a permanent username and password on first login.

Config.Name: Setup Password
Config.Description: First-run bootstrap password. Change this before exposing Daybook; it is only used for the initial setup login.

Config.Name: Display Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the Daybook interface
